facts.expected: Both shoppers and merchants need active accounts to submit.
Polish shoppers have a PLN 500 per-order self-service limit, with specialist approval above it.
Irish merchants have a EUR 500 per-order self-service limit, with specialist approval above it.
Both roles retain drafts for 30 days; legal holds extend this, with post-hold deletion time unknown.
The Review service validates delivery details on submission; complete goes to Validated, incomplete goes to Needs correction and back to the submitter.
Corrected resubmissions return to Submitted and repeat validation.
Validated orders within their applicable limit become Approved; larger orders go to Manual review, where only specialists approve. Manual rejection is undocumented.
Review hands the approved order identifier to Fulfilment after approval; Fulfilment records Queued. There is no stated delivery-time guarantee.
Every approval records role, decision and time; specialists inspect the history; its retention is unspecified.
The illustrative review panel supports checking delivery details before submission, applies to merchants too, and proves no additional behavior.

reader_questions: What differs between the two 500 limits, and what happens above each?
When can a draft remain after 30 days, and when is it then deleted?
What happens to incomplete delivery details, including after correction?
Who can approve manual review and what is known about rejection?
What passes to Fulfilment and does approval guarantee delivery timing?
What is recorded for approval, who sees it, and how long is it retained?

rubric.redundant_explanation: A second substantial explanation of the same scoped rule with no new qualification or local reader need; brief navigation or scoped comparisons do not count.
rubric.structure: 1: unordered list; 3: headings but mixed ownership; 5: clear canonical homes and short navigation.
rubric.clarity: 1: misleading merged scopes; 3: correct but repetitive; 5: compact shared explanations with explicit variants.
rubric.findability: 1: questions cannot be answered; 3: facts scattered; 5: questions answered with qualifications in one logical place.
rubric.visual_usefulness: 1: misleading or broken; 3: relevant but incomplete; 5: portable illustration and faithful branch diagram with text alternatives.
rubric.human_scoring: Pending independent human reader; agent assessment does not establish human acceptance.
